name: Clay Day
tagline: Become a handmade stop-motion clay character.
subject: the person
endFrame: Restyle the entire image as a handmade stop-motion claymation scene: {subject} becomes a plasticine clay figure with visible fingerprints, soft rounded shapes and slightly lumpy textures; the background becomes a miniature handcrafted clay set. Same composition and colours.
motion: The scene softens as if being sculpted: {subject}'s skin and clothes take on a soft plasticine texture with visible fingerprints, edges rounding into handmade clay shapes while the background turns into a miniature clay set. {subject} gives a small stop-motion style wave at the end, slightly jerky like animation at twelve frames per second.
sound: squishy clay sounds and a cheerful plucked-string jingle
